documents.title: Manager approval action
documents.content: For requests requiring manager approval use manager_approval. Approval needs explicit reviewer decision; never auto approve.

documents.title: Amount thresholds
documents.content: Use compare_number with field total_amount, operator greater_than and numeric threshold. Include both outcomes.

documents.title: Notification simulator
documents.content: send_notification writes to local outbox. It does not send live M365 mail or Teams messages.

documents.title: Mock list item operations
documents.content: Use create_list_item, lookup_list_item or update_list_item for local SharePoint-like records only.

documents.title: Agent safety rules
documents.content: Only allowlisted tools, no real tenant connections, no implicit approvals, audit all steps.
